The future of our planet needs more than good intentions. It needs capital, conviction, and community.
The future of our planet needs more than good intentions. It needs capital, conviction, and community.
The future of our planet needs more than good intentions. It needs capital, conviction, and community.

E8 exists to mobilize all three. We back early-stage companies building real solutions for a thriving planet: energy generation & storage, transportation, built environment, agriculture, water, and more. We do it together, as a community of investors who've seen that environmental impact and financial returns are complementary priorities.

Community is how we work. Members dig into companies together from screening through diligence, and make their own decisions about where to write checks. Founders who come through E8 leave better equipped, because we take time to understand their company and share honest feedback.

We've been investing since 2006, and we're here for the long run.

Portfolio

We've invested in over 180 companies. Here's a sample of our investments.

Energy Storage
Group 14
Silicon-carbon composite anode materials that boost lithium-ion battery energy density at lower cost.
Grid & Power
Arcadia
Arcadia Power is the first nationwide clean energy utility option providing anyone that pays an electric bill the choice to buy 100% wind power. Our software connects online utility accounts with a clean energy purchasing platform, and assumes the utility-customer relationship.
Sustainable Materials
Tidal Vision
Tidal Vision is the only zero waste producer of chitosan thanks to proprietary technology, with competitive advantages is price/COGS, service, and quality. Chitosan replaces many synthetic and often toxic chemicals in the market, often at a lower costs due to Tidal Vision's technology.
Clean Energy
NuCube
NuCube is developing a nuclear reactor to bring affordable power to remote areas and heat for industrial applications.
Materials
InventWood
SUPERWOOD is beautiful, durable - and stronger than steel.
Recycling & Waste
Cecilia
Transforming plastic waste into circular carbon nanomaterials — making plastic too valuable to discard
Grid & Power
Derapi
Derapi is building a universal API for Distributed Energy to accelerate software integration for Virtual Power Plants
Built Environment
NxLite
NxLite makes advanced energy control coatings for windows and window like substrates.
Transportation
Xeal
Xeal makes smart, reliable EV charging for apartments and businesses that works for every EV — even without Wi-Fi.
